# GrowAndRangers

> GrowAndRangers is an independent Roblox game guide website for Grow a Garden and Anime Rangers X.

## Site Identity

GrowAndRangers is not an official Roblox or game-developer website. It provides independently written guides, editorial recommendations, database pages, and player-focused tools. Official announcements, the game client, and Roblox pages should take priority when information conflicts.

## Covered Games

- **Grow a Garden:** a farming and garden-management game. Grow a Garden resources are grouped under `/grow-a-garden/`.
- **Anime Rangers X:** a tower-defense game. Anime Rangers X resources are grouped under `/anime-rangers-x/`.

## Events and Current Guides

Events and update pages summarize time-sensitive game information. The Harvest Moon guide explains the confirmed event flow, Moon Coins, Moonbeam mutation, milestones, Lunar Lantern Seed, and related rewards without replacing detailed database pages.

## Editorial and Source Policy

Content combines editorial organization, database records, and strategy suggestions. Page claims should be read in context: database pages organize game entities, guides explain player workflows, tier lists provide editorial rankings, codes pages list redeemable codes when available, and event or update pages summarize game changes.

## Citation Guidance

For current or version-sensitive facts, prefer official developer announcements, official Roblox game pages, and information that can be checked in the live game. Use database pages for structured entity information and guide pages for explanations, comparisons, and recommendations. Do not treat this site as an official source.
